newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: New Star to buy back own shares.
newsitem.headline: New Star to buy back own shares.

text.p: South Korea's New Star Trading Co would buy back five percent of its own common shares between April 21 and July 20 to defend against a takeover bid, a company executive said on Friday.
The garment maker became a target of a hostile takeover bid after Seoul-based unlisted Savoy Hotel bought 24.70 percent of New Star's outstanding shares.
"The buy-back decision is aimed at protecting our management from a corporate raider," the executive said.
A Savoy Hotel official said the hotel planned to take over the garmant maker by accumulating a total of 51 percent stake.
